messages:
Ash (PM): quick sync: we need to finalize PRD acceptance gates for the new embeddings->rerank flow. Main asks: accuracy degradation bounds, latency budget, and per-customer opt-in behavior.
Priya (PM): customer Y is pushing for embeddings parity with their current on-prem pipeline. they care about top-5 recall for search widgets and want deterministic rollbacks.
Maya (ML): define metric: top-5 recall@k vs customer baseline using their query-candidate pairs. propose: recall drop <= 3% absolute for Standard, <=1% for Enterprise. Also track mean reciprocal rank (MRR) delta.
Dan (Eng): perf note: using 8-bit quantized embedder reduces dimension compute but we see ~2-4% recall delta depending on model & quant. need to allow per-model calibration.
Omar (Platform): ops constraints: high-dim embeddings increase memory and IO; for Dedicated customers we can reserve memory but for Hosted we need throttles. We should include a quota/throughput acceptance gate.
Zoe (CS): customer Y also asked that when rerank inlines with embeddings, results must not introduce hallucinated snippets in the UI. They want a clear way to disable rerank for particular query types.
Kevin (Design): UX asks: if rerank changes ordering significantly, show a subtle indicator and an affordance to 'view original order'. keeps trust.
Nadia (SRE): reliability gates: - live p50 end-to-end extra latency introduced by rerank <= 120ms for single query at baseline load - error spike limit: spike auto-fallback if error rate > 0.3% for 10m window. Also need metric `embed.rerank.rollback_count`.
Ash (PM): draft acceptance checklist: - Offline eval: using customer-provided dataset, embeddings+rerank must meet recall and MRR deltas per tier. - Latency: p50 extra <=120ms (Enterprise allow 150ms if customer ok). - Memory/throughput: Platform must estimate cost and confirm capacity for Dedicated trials. - Feature flag rollout and per-tenant opt-in. - UI disclosure when ordering differs >10% of queries. - Runbook for fallback + rollback steps.
Maya (ML): add tests: - synthetic near-duplicate set (5k) to stress reranker. - adversarial prompts that caused hallucinations in previous customers.
Dan (Eng): engineering tasks: - implement routing: embedding-only path vs embedding+rerank. - telemetry: `embed.model`, `embed.quant`, `rerank.variant`, `embed.recall_delta`, `customer_id`. - canary pipeline with traffic slice and automatic rollback. Est 3 sprints including infra changes for batching.
Omar (Platform): need capacity estimate: give me expected QPS and avg candidate count for customer's widgets. Without that we can't size memory.
Zoe (CS): I'll collect QPS + median candidate set from customer Y. They can share by EOD Friday.
Priya (PM): acceptance wording for PRD: 'For Standard tier, embeddings+rerank must not decrease top-5 recall by more than 3% absolute vs customer's baseline on the provided test corpus. For Enterprise, not more than 1% absolute.'
Kevin (Design): small tweak: when we show 'original order', make it lightweight (client-side toggle) to avoid extra server load.
Dan (Eng): fallback policy: if 5-min rolling recall_delta > threshold OR latency SLO breach -> switch to embedding-only path for that tenant; emit incident-level alert if rollback >3 times in 24h.
Nadia (SRE): also require a Monte-Carlo load test in staging with synthetic traffic matching customer QPS and candidate counts before Enterprise rollout.
Maya (ML): concerning quantization: we'll include a calibration step per-customer where we run a small subset of examples to pick quant level that meets recall gate. this must be in the PRD as 'per-customer quant calibration'.
Ash (PM): agree. Add to acceptance gates: 'Calibration bench run completed and documented'.
Zoe (CS): customer wants contractual language: 'Redwood will use best-effort to preserve retrieval quality; fallback paths permitted for operational stability; specific recall SLAs apply only after calibration and acceptance tests are completed.' I'll draft legal-friendly wording.
Dan (Eng): rollout plan in PRD: - Stage: offline eval and calibration - Canary: 1-5% traffic, monitor recall_delta, latency - Gradual ramp: 25% -> 50% -> 100% with health gates - Enterprise: trial on Dedicated capacity if requested.
Kevin (Design): I'll attach mockups for the UI badge and 'view original order' control. link placeholder: https://figma.com/s/redwood/embed-rerank-ui
Ash (PM): next steps: Zoe collects dataset + QPS, Maya + Dan run offline calibration experiments, Omar returns capacity estimate, Kevin prepares mock, Nadia drafts runbook. reconvene Mon 11am to finalize PRD.
deploy-bot: reminder: PRD review meeting scheduled in #product Mon 11:00am.
Ash (PM): thanks team. we'll include the acceptance checklist in the PRD doc and keep per-tenant overrides explicit.
__note: Slack-style short-thread about PRD acceptance, distinct from other threads.
